paragraphs.text: Great Shaper Pashona is a merfolk shaman of the River Heralds on Ixalan . She is one of the nine leading shapers of the River Heralds and the mother of Nicanzil .
Pashona is a wizened merfolk. She has green skin mottled with brownish-pink spots and pink fins that flare out behind her like a cape. She wears jade armor but carries no weapons.
After the death of the Deeproot Tree in the New Phyrexian Invasion , Pashona rediscovered the ancient city of Matzalantli .
Afterward, she was summoned by Shaper Tishana to a tribal congress so that they can decide together the fate of the plane.
